title: Stage-2 common SSE/SZSE official-session calendar

semantics.row_meaning: One common official session on which both SSE and SZSE are open; closed dates are omitted.
semantics.boundary_rule: Include every authoritative common session in both boundary months; do not fabricate closed-day rows to match calendar-month endpoints.
semantics.quote_membership_rule: Every quote date used by Stage 2 must appear exactly once in this calendar.
semantics.endpoint_rule: The first monthly rebalance and every fixed t+20 and t+21 endpoint must resolve by position in this calendar; a missing symbol row never shifts the endpoint.
semantics.exchange_disagreement_rule: Fail closed until authoritative evidence establishes whether both SSE and SZSE were open.

hash_rule: SHA-256 over the exact CSV bytes without normalization after design freeze.
